hook.say: The ten highest capital cities on Earth, ranked. Number one is over two miles high!

outro.say: Which one would you visit? Comment below!

items.name: Nairobi
items.say: Number ten: Nairobi, where lions roam nearby. 1795 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Nairobi, where lions roam nearby. 1,795 meters.

items.name: Tehran
items.say: Nine: Tehran, below the Alborz mountains. 1830 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Tehran, below the Alborz mountains. 1,830 meters.

items.name: Mexico City
items.say: Eight: Mexico City, built on an ancient lake bed. 2240 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Mexico City, built on an ancient lake bed. 2,240 meters.

items.name: Sanaa
items.say: Seven: Sah-nah, one of Earth's oldest cities. 2250 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Sanaa, one of Earth's oldest cities. 2,250 meters.

items.name: Asmara
items.say: Six: Asmara, famous for its Art Deco streets. 2325 meters.
items.cap: Six: Asmara, famous for its Art Deco streets. 2,325 meters.

items.name: Thimphu
items.say: Five: Tim-poo, a capital with no traffic lights. 2334 meters.
items.cap: Five: Thimphu, a capital with no traffic lights. 2,334 meters.

items.name: Addis Ababa
items.say: Four: Addis Ababa, the highest capital in Africa. 2355 meters.
items.cap: Four: Addis Ababa, the highest capital in Africa. 2,355 meters.

items.name: Bogotá
items.say: Three: Bogota, high on an Andean plateau. 2625 meters.
items.cap: Three: Bogotá, high on an Andean plateau. 2,625 meters.

items.name: Quito
items.say: Two: Kee-toe, sitting almost on the Equator. 2850 meters.
items.cap: Two: Quito, sitting almost on the Equator. 2,850 meters.

items.name: La Paz
items.say: And number one: Lah Pahz, Bolivia! 3640 meters, over two miles above the sea.
items.cap: And number one: La Paz, Bolivia! 3,640 meters, over two miles above the sea.
